gloss: that way, like that; oh, ah

definitions.explanation: Refers to a manner or state distant from both speaker and listener. Part of the ko-so-a-do demonstrative system.
An exclamation expressing various emotions like realization, satisfaction, or disappointment.

examples.japanese: ああいう⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become that kind of person.
examples.notes: ああいう = that kind of

examples.japanese: ああ、⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
ああ⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: It was my first time seeing someone cook like that.
examples.notes: ああやって = like that, that way

examples.japanese: ああ、⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}した→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧！⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Oh, I remember! That person is someone I met last year.

examples.english: By doing this and that, it was completed.
Always having a retort for everything.

examples.japanese: ああ、⟦おいしかった→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
ああ、⟦{残念|ざんねん}→残念：01244_zannen⟧！
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ああいう⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: It's not good for children to talk like that.
examples.notes: ああいう = that kind of

notes:
ああ belongs to the ko-so-a-do system: ⟦こう→こう：01157_kou⟧ (this way), ⟦そう→そう：01167_sou⟧ (that way, near listener), ああ (that way, far from both). As an interjection, it can express realization, relief, disappointment, or other emotions depending on tone.

Common patterns:
- ⟦ああいう→ああいう：16591_aaiu⟧ (that kind of)
- ああ⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (like that, doing it that way).
